metadata.description: An engraved Venetian sea chart of 1764, of anywhere: OpenFreeMap's water masked and its coast inked by a wobbling hand, the smallest lakes, the narrowest rivers and close in the piers left out; water lines packed close along every shore, the land grown out in six blurred steps whose staircase a Laplacian turns into lines, and further out two fathom lines from a wide blur of the land; Mapterhorn's relief engraved as stipple on steep and shadowed faces and form lines across them, the low ground left clean; woods as rings of trees close in, cliffs as fine toothed rules; dense town cores hatched in carmine; names in Italian where the tiles have it, towns in spaced capitals by a ringed dot, villages in italic, the waters along their axes, all on paper halos; on parchment under a darkened rim, framed by a double rule graduated between.
